title: The LIT lawsuit read, the four consumed operations, the filing clocks and the requirement identifier have no owner, no element and no value in the sources read
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E5-010, story, data table, endpoints table); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md row FEAT-LIT-10 ('matches them to the LIT lawsuit read through v_ace_lawsuit'); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S4 Litigation and enforcement v3.md A2.10; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md rows R-LIT-30, R-LIT-31 and R-LIT-32 (timer columns); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S4 Litigation and enforcement v2.md T3.1, T4, T5.2, T5.3 and T-A.1; _work/msr/context/S4.md (ownership rows of S4: 2 tables, 5 operations, 0 events, 0 jobs, 1 workflow; no v_ace_* grant)
section: RWB-S4-E5010-APP sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 12.2, 12.3, 12.4, 12.5, 12.8, 13, 14 and 19; RWB-S4-E5010-CON sections 2, 3, 7 (AC2 to AC6), 8 (BR3 to BR6, BR11), 11, 12.1, 12.2, 12.3, 12.4, 12.5, 13 and 19; the metadata rows and the two fragments
description: Six values the step needs are fixed by no source read for this key. (1) The LIT lawsuit: FEAT-LIT-10 in the Epics 3 to 8 specification says the filing is matched to the LIT lawsuit read through v_ace_lawsuit, while the FSD A2.10 says only 'Partner portal, LIT' and rwb-litigation holds no v_ace_* grant, so the read cannot be this service's own and no element of v_ace_lawsuit is published. (2) The case read and the move: TSD S4 T5.2 says only 'P3 for the case', and neither the read of the route state FIRM_INSTRUCTED or FILED_IN_COURT nor the answer carrying FILED_IN_COURT or FILING_REJECTED, the officer task and the rule version has an operation name. (3) The pack: the return for rework that R-LIT-31 names is a request to rwb-document and no operation name or request shape is published. (4) The firm receipt: the portal upload of the filing receipt and court case number is rwb-partner's through the partner gateway and neither its operation nor its element is published. (5) The clocks: R-LIT-30 gives 'Filing service level by task' and R-LIT-31 gives '5 working days' with no duration, no working-day calendar and no statement that the clock is the litigation workflow's, while the timer row DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036 the legacy data table names is P3's; the hearing timers that the same rule sets belong to the hearing stage of the same workflow and no source says how the two stages split. (6) The requirement: the legacy master, the Epics 3 to 8 specification and TSD S4 T8 carry no REQ identifier for this feature.
evidence: Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 line for FEAT-LIT-10: 'Takes the filing confirmation and the court case number from the firm onto the case, and matches them to the LIT lawsuit read through v_ace_lawsuit.' FSD S4 A2.10.2: 'Integration points. Partner portal, LIT'. Business Rules and Routing Logic v4: R-LIT-30 timer 'Filing service level by task', R-LIT-31 timer '5 working days', R-LIT-32 timer '3 working days'. TSD S4 T5.2: 'P3 for the case, P7 for the decision log, P4 for access and reference data, P5 for documents, P6 for notices'. TSD S4 T5.3: 'Events ... None'. Context pack: 'Tables (2) hearing, legal_action', 'REST operations provided (5)', 'Events (0)', 'Jobs (0)', 'Workflows (1) LitigationWorkflow'. Legacy data table: 'timer | id, case_id, task_id, timer_type, started_at, expires_at and 4 more | DF-WRK-027 to DF-WRK-036'. Legacy metadata table: seven rows, no requirement row.
owner_role: Business analyst, S4, with the solution architect, the API owner and the rwb-case, rwb-document, rwb-partner, rwb-source-data and rwb-decision tech leads
proposed: The LIT lawsuit and the case, pack and firm facts are consumed on the owner contracts with the placeholder operation names, the two clocks are durable timers of LitigationWorkflow on rwb-litigation with versioned reference rows, and both stories trace to FEAT-LIT-10 and OBJ-3 until the owners publish the operations, the element and the requirement.

title: The update element names courtCaseNo while the row and the response name black_case_no, and it carries neither a filing date nor a defect field
source: _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench API Specification v4.yaml (components LegalAction and LegalActionUpdate, and the PATCH /legal-actions/{legalActionId} operation); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD S4 Litigation and enforcement v2.md T3.1 (DF-LEG-005, DF-LEG-006, DF-LEG-010, DF-LEG-014) and T-A.2; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD S4 Litigation and enforcement v3.md A2.10.3.2 (field catalogue of eight fields); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md R-LIT-31 (defect record)
section: RWB-S4-E5010-CON sections 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 (AC1 and AC7), 8 (BR7), 11, 12.1, 12.8, 13 and 19; RWB-S4-E5010-APP sections 2, 4, 7, 9, 11 and 12.1
description: The published update element of API-S4-004 is LegalActionUpdate with four properties only: status, courtCaseNo, judgmentDate and judgmentAmount. The legal action row and the LegalAction response carry blackCaseNo, lawsuitNo, redCaseNo, courtName, claimAmount, filedDate, judgmentDate, judgmentAmount, litStatus and status, and there is no courtCaseNo field in either and no filedDate in the request. The FSD field catalogue of A2.10 lists eight fields (case_id, law_firm_id, action_type, lawsuit_no, black_case_no, red_case_no, court_name, claim_amount) and no defect field, while R-LIT-31 requires the defect of a returned filing to be recorded. The mapping of courtCaseNo, the source of filed_date and the home of the defect are therefore decided by assumption and not by a source.
evidence: API Specification v4, LegalActionUpdate: properties status (enum OPEN, FILED, JUDGMENT, ENFORCING, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN), courtCaseNo, judgmentDate, judgmentAmount. LegalAction: blackCaseNo, lawsuitNo, redCaseNo, filedDate, litStatus, status and no courtCaseNo. TSD S4 T3.1: DF-LEG-006 black_case_no varchar(30), DF-LEG-010 filed_date date, DF-LEG-014 status LOV-LEGAL-STATUS. FSD S4 A2.10.3.2: eight field rows and no defect field. Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-LIT-31: 'Record the defect and return the pack for rework'.
owner_role: API owner with the solution architect and the rwb-litigation tech lead, at the wave 3 contract freeze
proposed: Read courtCaseNo as legal_action.black_case_no, set filed_date from the receipt date of the firm with the business date where the receipt carries none, and keep the defect in the decision record's inputs reference and in the case route state FILING_REJECTED, with no new list value and no new column.
